player_prompt.intro:
Ka mātakitaki koe i ngā uara huna {N} i te tīmata mai.
I ia wāhi, tīpāta [accept] ki te pīki i te uara o nāianei, ki te kore, tīpāta [continue] ki te karo i a ia, ā, ka kite i te uara e whai ake.
Ki te kore koe e whakaae, ka whakawhiua koe ki te tango i te uara whakamutunga.
Ka wini koe (utu = 1) **anake** ki te mea ko te uara i pīki ai koe i te mutunga ko te uara teitei rawa o te katoa.

game_action.current_value: Ko te uara o nāianei ko {value}.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Me whakaputa te mahi ki te tuhituhi rite, me [accept], me [continue] ranei.

outcome.summary: I whakaae koe ki te uara {value} i te tīpoka {draw_num}/{N}. Ko te mea pai rawa atu ko {best}. {result}
outcome.not_max: Ehara i te mea nui rawa.
